level.description: Search one level only. Left out, a search covers this project and the device.

projects.description: Also search these other projects, read-only. Nothing outside this project is searched unless named here.

scope.description: Search exactly this scope. Left out, search the resolved project scope plus general and unscoped notes. Explicitly named peer projects are searched across scopes.

limit.description: At most this many hits; 10 when absent.

cursor.description: Continue from the previous result: its next value, with the same level and projects.
